body: In SLP(C) 29482/2009 (free-treatment matter), GNCTD told the Supreme Court that the lease of the Sarita Vihar land expired 31-Jul-2023 and the JV agreement with Apollo on 10-Mar-2018; IMCL proposed a 30-year renewal on 09-May-2025; GNCTD's 27-Jan-2026 affidavit says renewal now would be 'contrary to public interest and contractual discipline' (press reports). IMCL's board 'noted' the affidavit on 03-Feb-2026 (NSE filing 09-Feb-2026) without describing it. Earlier: SC 25-Mar-2025 warned of an AIIMS takeover; GNCTD (Nov-2025) said EWS delivery was 9-10% OPD / 7-9% IPD vs the lease's 40%/33%.
title: Delhi government affidavit opposes renewal of Indraprastha Apollo's land lease and JV agreement (27-Jan-2026)
